title: UserProvMockTarget - Data API
description: Represents an entity for testing user data before committing the data to a third-party system for user provisioning.

ExternalEmail.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalEmail.description: The email address as stored in the target system for the associated user account.

ExternalFirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ExternalLastName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalLastName.description: The last name as stored in the target system for the associated user account.

ExternalUserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalUserId.description: The unique identifier for the user as stored in the target system.

ExternalUsername.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalUsername.description: The username as stored in the target system for the associated user account.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The unique name for this object.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The user ID of the owner of this object—typically a Salesforce administrator.
